source: Three things are visible in this tiny example. First, the endpoints can be represented almost exactly when the scale is derived from the maximum magnitude. Second, interior values move to the nearest grid point. Third, with round-to-nearest, an unclipped scalar is displaced by at most roughly half one quantization step (apart from tie-breaking conventions).
zh: 在这个小例子中可以看到三件事。首先，当从最大幅度导出尺度时，可以几乎准确地表示端点。其次，内部值移动到最近的网格点。第三，通过舍入到最接近的值，未裁剪的标量最多被替换大约半个量化步长（除了打破平局的惯例）。
